## Module 0 Question 1
# Task: Predicting student comfort with statistics using class experience
# Response: stat.comf
# Predictors: courses (PSTAT 115, PSTAT 160, PSTAT 171, PSTAT 175)

```{r}
# load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
# Load data and select variables of interest
class_data <- read_csv("../data/background-clean.csv") %>% 
  select(response_id, stat.comf, courses)
head(class_data)
```
```{r}
class_data <- class_data %>% 
  mutate(
    pstat_115 = if_else(str_detect(courses, 'PSTAT 115'),'Yes', 'No'),
    pstat_160 = if_else(str_detect(courses, 'PSTAT 160'), 'Yes', 'No'),
    pstat_171 = if_else(str_detect(courses, 'PSTAT 171'), 'Yes', 'No'),
    pstat_175 = if_else(str_detect(courses, 'PSTAT 175'), 'Yes', 'No')
    )
head(class_data)

```
